text: DOJ Corporate Enforcement Actions (Karl's data bank, retrieved 2026-10-09). Total: 11 actions, $4.03 billion in penalties. Top cases: TD Bank N.A. / TD Bank US Holding Company — $1887M (Bank Secrecy Act / Money Laundering Conspiracy, 2024-10-10); Perfectus Aluminum Inc. et al. — $550M (False Claims Act / Customs Duty Evasion, 2026-05-12); The Boeing Company — $487M (Criminal Fraud Conspiracy (737 MAX), 2024-07-24); Applied Materials Inc. — $252M (Export Control (EAR) Violations, 2026-02-01); GVA Capital Ltd. — $216M (Russia Sanctions (OFAC), 2025-01-01). Source: DOJ press releases, justice.gov. Pattern: Bank Secrecy Act violations (TD Bank $1.89B, largest ever), False Claims Act customs fraud, FCPA foreign bribery, 737 MAX fraud conspiracy.

Defense Contractor Misconduct (POGO database via Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 20 incidents, $5.44 billion in penalties. Top offenders: Boeing Company — $2514M (2021-01-07); Boeing Company — $615M (2006-01-01); Raytheon Company — $574M (2024-10-16); Booz Allen Hamilton — $377M (2023-01-01); Northrop Grumman Corporation — $325M (2009-01-01). Source: DOJ press releases, SEC filings, court records (POGO FCMD retired 2022). Boeing leads at $3.19B across 4 incidents including $2.5B 737 MAX fraud. RTX/Raytheon $1.19B including Qatar bribes and defective pricing.

Healthcare Fraud Enforcement (HHS OIG, Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 13 actions, $3.20 billion in penalties. Top cases: Omnicare / CVS Health — $949M (2025-08-01); Kaiser Permanente — $556M (2026-01-14); Florida provider group (retirement community) — $542M (2026-08-26); Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — $425M (2024-10-10); McKinsey & Company — $323M (2025-01-01). Source: HHS OIG, DOJ. Dominant pattern: Medicare Advantage diagnosis-code inflation — Kaiser $556M (largest MA settlement ever), Omnicare/CVS $949M (3M+ false claims). FY2025 was record: $6.8B recovered under False Claims Act.

Private Prison Industry (Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 30 facilities tracked. Operators: GEO Group (19), CoreCivic (9), Immigration Centers of America (1), Management & Training Corp (1). ICE pays $128-$185 per person per day (avg ~$144). GEO Group: ~$2B revenue 2025 (43% from ICE), $254M profit (+700%). CoreCivic: ~$2B revenue, ICE revenue doubled $120M to $245M. 85%+ of ICE beds privately operated. $45B in new detention contracts announced 2025. BOP ended all private contracts Nov 2022; ban rescinded Jan 2025. Source: openimmigration.us, ACLU, SEC 10-K filings, DOJ OIG.

FCC Telecom Enforcement (Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Major fines: T-Mobile $80M, AT&T $57M, Verizon ~$47M — total ~$196M for unlawful customer location-data sales (CPNI violations, 2024). SCOTUS upheld FCC authority 8-1 (June 2026). Consumer complaints (12 months): 112,465 billing-fraud-adjacent — phone billing 74K, internet billing 29K, cramming 8K, slamming 1.2K. Unwanted calls: 129,542 complaints. Source: FCC opendata.socrata.com, enforcement actions.

For-Profit College Industry (Dept of Ed College Scorecard, Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 2,261 for-profit schools, 1.23M students enrolled. Major fraud cases: Corinthian Colleges (closed 2015, $5.8B debt discharged), ITT Tech (closed 2016, $1.5B discharged), University of Phoenix (FTC $191M settlement 2019, largest ever), DeVry ($100M FTC 2016). Closed schools include: . Pattern: enroll students, load with debt, close suddenly. Taxpayers absorb discharged loans.

Institutional Investor Holdings — 13F Filings (SEC EDGAR, Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 335 positions across 9 major fund managers. Managers: Bank of America (34), Berkshire Hathaway (23), BlackRock (27), Goldman Sachs (33), Invesco (44), JPMorgan (42), Morgan Stanley (35), State Street (50), Vanguard (47). Shows what the big money owns: BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street (the Big Three index giants), Berkshire Hathaway (concentrated positions), Goldman, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, BofA. Useful for tracking which funds profit from which corporations. Most data Q2 2026 (filed Aug 2026). Source: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR filings.

Corporate Power Networks — LittleSis (Karl's data bank, 2026-10-09). Total: 60 people, 199 board positions across 15 major companies (Walmart, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Exxon, JPMorgan, J&J, Chevron, Pfizer, BofA, Goldman, Boeing, Lockheed, GE, Ford). Board interlocks found: Ronald D. Sugar sits on both Apple and Chevron boards. Tracks revolving door (gov officials to corporate boards) and shared directors. Source: LittleSis.org API (CC-BY-SA 4.0).
